source_title: Epwin Group Annual Report and Accounts 2019
availability_evidence: The issuer's 23 April 2020 primary results announcement states that the 2019 financial statements were approved by the Board on 22 April 2020; the corresponding Companies House-filed accounts are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue was broadly flat at £282.1m amid second-half market softening. Pre-IFRS 16 underlying operating profit rose to £19.1m from £18.7m and underlying margin edged up to 6.8% from 6.7%; underlying cash conversion remained very strong at 123%, covenant net debt fell to £16.4m and leverage to 0.6x. Site complexity caused inefficiency while footprint consolidation, redundancies and Telford relocation were already underway. By publication, COVID-19 had caused a temporary operating pause and the final dividend was withheld to conserve liquidity, with approximately £45m facility headroom reported at 31 March 2020.
already_announced_exclusion: The Cardiff closure, footprint consolidation, Telford warehousing relocation, redundancies, sale-and-leaseback programme, temporary COVID-19 operating pause and announced liquidity actions were public or underway before cutoff and are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Market softening, site inefficiency and the pre-cutoff pandemic shutdown create material pressure. Stable underlying profit and margin, strong cash conversion, falling debt, low leverage and material headroom provide substantial contrary evidence; all identified interventions were already announced.

source_title: Epwin Group Annual Report and Accounts 2021
availability_evidence: Annual report page 104 states that the financial statements were approved and authorised for issue by the Board on 6 April 2022; the corresponding Companies House-filed accounts are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue reached a record £329.6m, 37% above 2020 and 17% above 2019. Underlying operating profit recovered to £18.5m from £9.4m but remained below £21.2m in 2019, while underlying margin improved to 5.6% from 3.9% but remained 190bps below 2019 because material-cost inflation was recovered with a lag. Pre-tax operating cash flow was £34.9m, cash conversion 189%, covenant net debt fell to £9.4m and leverage to 0.4x with over £65m facility headroom. Supply-chain, material and labour availability and inflation pressures remained significant.
already_announced_exclusion: The Telford consolidation and inventory relocation, prior fabrication rationalisation, COVID-19 reorganisation, sites closed or committed to close, acquisitions and implemented price or surcharge actions were public or underway before cutoff and are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Severe input inflation, labour and supply-chain pressure and margin remaining below 2019 warrant material pressure scores. Record revenue, restored profitability, exceptional cash conversion, falling debt, low leverage and ample headroom provide very strong contrary evidence.
